name: temporary-drop
description: Share once. Disappear forever. Accountless, expiring, download-limited file sharing.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
